entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who unmakes her lich brother Josu with the Chain Veil and learns her family died trying to end the curse she created.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who rallies the Benalish forces and distracts a dread shade while Liliana unmakes Josu.

entities.name: Josu Vess
entities.description: Liliana's brother, a lich general of the Cabal in Caligo, who is laid to rest by the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Raven Man
entities.description: A pale figure in black with golden eyes who stalks Liliana across planes and refuses to undo Josu's fate.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: The demon lord of the Cabal who raised Josu as a lich to weaken Liliana.

entities.name: Rael
entities.description: An angel who led the Benalish forces against the Cabal in Caligo and agrees to Gideon's plan.

entities.name: Thiago
entities.description: A Benalish knight, Rael's second in command.

entities.name: Corin
entities.description: A young Tolarian mage who creates an illusion for Gideon.

entities.name: Gerrel
entities.description: The innkeeper of the town of Vess who sent Gideon to Rael.

entities.name: Drasus
entities.description: One of Gideon's Irregulars from Akros, seen in a dementia illusion.

entities.name: Olexo
entities.description: One of Gideon's Irregulars from Akros, seen in a dementia illusion.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon the group means to destroy.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: The death cult led by Belzenlok whose undead hold Caligo.

entities.name: Benalish forces
entities.description: The surviving Benalish soldiers, knights and aven scouts rallied by Rael.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: An artifact binding Onakke spirits that destroys undead and demons at the cost of Liliana's strength.

entities.name: Dread Shade
entities.description: A giant undead creature leading the Cabal force, hungry and easily provoked.

entities.name: Skin Witches
entities.description: Death mages who wear the skins of their living victims, serving Josu.

entities.name: Vess Manor
entities.description: Liliana's ruined family home where Josu was made undead and finally laid to rest.

entities.name: Vess
entities.description: The town where Gideon and Liliana are staying.

entities.name: Caligo Morass
entities.description: The marsh where the Cabal operates.

entities.name: Aerona
entities.description: A place Gideon hopes to free from the Cabal.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: The land where Vess lies.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: The Cabal's stronghold that Liliana vows to open.

entities.name: Onakke
entities.description: Spirits bound in the Chain Veil.

events.summary: Liliana searches the Morass for the Raven Man, shouting for him to face her.
events.quote: I know you're here! Face me, damn you!

events.summary: The Raven Man appears from a swirl of ravens.
events.quote: Out of that mass stepped the Raven Man.

events.summary: The Raven Man says Josu cannot be laid to rest and that Liliana should have followed him.
events.quote: It can't be done.

events.summary: The Raven Man vanishes with his ravens.
events.quote: he and every raven in sight abruptly vanished.

events.summary: Liliana realizes Belzenlok used Josu to make her too weak to use the Chain Veil against him.
events.quote: He knew if Liliana used the Chain Veil to unmake Josu, it would leave her so weak she wouldn't be able to use it to destroy Belzenlok.

events.summary: Liliana tells Gideon the lich leading the Cabal is her brother Josu.
events.quote: The lich leading the Cabal forces in this area is my brother, Josu.

events.summary: Liliana confesses she made Josu undead as a girl.
events.quote: I made Josu undead, many years ago.

events.summary: Gideon agrees to help lay Josu to rest as the next step.
events.quote: Yes, that's our next step, obviously.

events.summary: Gideon and Liliana find Rael in a ruin and offer help against the Cabal.
events.quote: We know you're Rael, Battle Angel and Protector of Caligo.

events.summary: Rael accepts and asks to hear their plan.
events.quote: Tell me your plan.

events.summary: Gideon gathers the Benalish forces at Vess Manor.
events.quote: When the next day dawned, they were at the high ground around Vess Manor with a small force of Benalish soldiers, knights, and aven scouts.

events.summary: Gideon asks Corin to make a dread shade mistake him for a skin witch.
events.quote: Corin, with Liliana's help, could you create an illusion? Make a dread shade think I'm a skin witch?

events.summary: Corin casts the illusion over Gideon.
events.quote: As Corin cast the spell, Gideon felt the illusion settle over him like a wet blanket.

events.summary: A Cabal cleric's dementia magic shows Gideon undead versions of his friends Drasus and Olexo.
events.quote: They were undead, their bodies mutilated, bloodless corpses, brought here somehow by Belzenlok.

events.summary: Gideon spears the dread shade to lure it away from the Benalish.
events.quote: Gideon lunged forward and cast the spear straight at the gaping hole in the shade's chest.

events.summary: Gideon beheads a skin witch.
events.quote: The first stroke of his sword took her head off.

events.summary: The dread shade drains another skin witch.
events.quote: the dread shade was drinking the life force out of her.

events.summary: Gideon kills the last skin witch as the illusion fades.
events.quote: As she fell to the ground, Gideon felt the illusion around him vanish.

events.summary: Gideon charges the confused dread shade to keep it busy.
events.quote: He roared back at the startled shade and charged.

events.summary: Liliana calls to Josu through the wind, drawing him to the manor.
events.quote: Josu Vess, I am here.

events.summary: Josu appears in spiked dark armor as Belzenlok's lich general.
events.quote: The magic that had transformed him from a mindless undead remnant into Belzenlok's lich general had covered his shape with dark metal armor.

events.summary: Liliana draws on the Chain Veil, killing undead across the Morass.
events.quote: The Onakke bound into the Chain Veil whispered in her mind as she drew on raw power.

events.summary: The Veil destroys Josu, leaving his decomposing corpse.
events.quote: crumpled before her on the paving stones was the decomposing corpse of her brother.

events.summary: The Chain Veil blasts away the preserved manor, aging it into ruin.
events.quote: the Chain Veil had blasted it all away, aging the house until it was a crumbled ruin.

events.summary: With his last words Josu blames Liliana for the curse of the House of Vess.
events.quote: You killed me. You killed them.

events.summary: Josu dissolves into dust.
events.quote: And he was gone.

events.summary: Liliana realizes her family died trying to end the evil she created.
events.quote: And worse still, her family, all dead trying to end the evil she had created.

events.summary: Liliana vows to destroy Belzenlok's Stronghold.
events.quote: I will pry open his Stronghold, slaughter his grimnants, and destroy his legacy.

relations.quote: The lich leading the Cabal forces in this area is my brother, Josu.
The magic that had transformed him from a mindless undead remnant into Belzenlok's lich general had covered his shape with dark metal armor.

relations.note: She recalls having killed him long ago.
Rael led the Benalish forces against the Cabal.
relations.quote: You led the Benalish forces against the Cabal here.

relations.note: Thiago is Rael's second in command.
relations.quote: a Benalish knight who was Rael's second in command
If they could really work together as allies, anything was possible.

relations.note: The Raven Man manipulated Liliana into the healing that raised Josu.
relations.quote: The Raven Man had manipulated her, tricked her into performing the work, yes

relations.note: Rael accepts Gideon's help against the Cabal.
